technique_name: Explain the importance of having good health in the context of personal and public wellbeing.
description: Good health is essential to achieving personal and public wellbeing. Optimal health provides us with the energy and resources to fully engage in our daily lives, both professionally and socially. Healthy habits such as exercise, nutrition, and adequate sleep, can also prevent and manage physical and mental illnesses, helping us to stay productive and happy.
